objects.name: Detection technique coverage: gsuite-suspicious-shared-file-name
objects.description: The following analytic detects shared files in Google Drive with suspicious filenames commonly used in spear phishing campaigns. It leverages GSuite Drive logs to identify documents with titles that include keywords like "dhl," "ups," "invoice," and "shipment." This activity is significant because such filenames are often used to lure users into opening malicious documents or clicking harmful links.
